name: Beam Cloud On-demand - H100 PCIe
price_basis: per H100 PCIe machine-hour, on-demand, including 26 vCPU + 200 GB RAM + 1 TB NVMe. Fetched 2026-10-04. This is a per-machine rate for a single-GPU machine, so it is also the per-GPU rate. The machine includes CPU, RAM, and storage.
notes: Beam on-demand H100 PCIe at $1.83/hr is the cheapest published H100 rate from any managed provider. It is 50% below Together AI's on-demand H100 ($3.99), 64% below CoreWeave ($6.16), and 73% below AWS p5 ($6.88). The rate includes the full machine (26 vCPU, 200GB RAM, 1TB NVMe), making it an all-in price. Beam also offers a serverless H100 at $3.50/hr (per-second billing) which is more expensive for sustained workloads. Beam charges no egress fees on any plan. The H100 PCIe is the PCIe variant, not SXM - it has lower bandwidth and no NVLink, making it less suitable for multi-GPU training but fine for single-GPU inference.
